stiffness.label: Stiffness (flat-part proxy)
stiffness.explain: Bending stiffness of the printed material per layer, relative to a solid part of the same height. Beam theory with perfect layer bonding: compare variants of one flat part, not different parts.

quality.label: Quality (proxy)
quality.explain: How the print should look, from its toolpaths: step height on slopes, outer wall speed, speed over air (overhangs and bridges), top surface speed and the solid layers under the top. 100% is as good as the current settings; each aspect counts by the surface it covers. Rules of thumb, not a measurement of a print.

near_cap_s.label: Time at the flow cap
near_cap_s.explain: Printing time at 95% or more of the filament's max volumetric speed. Less is more headroom against under-extrusion.

knobs.label: Bridge speed
knobs.explain: Speed of bridges over air or sparse infill. Faster bridges can sag; slower ones hang straighter.

knobs.label: Top shell layers
knobs.explain: Solid layers under the top surface. Fewer is faster and lighter; too few can show infill through the top, which the quality proxy counts.
knobs.note: Bambu keeps the top shells at least as thick as Top shell thickness (1 mm by default), so that is set to 0 whenever this changes.

knobs.label: Bottom shell layers
knobs.explain: Solid layers above the bed-side surface.
knobs.note: Bottom shell thickness is set to 0 whenever this changes, for the same reason as the top shells.

knobs.label: Infill density
knobs.explain: How much plastic fills the inside.

knobs.label: Infill pattern
knobs.explain: Shape of the inside fill. Gyroid has no crossings on one layer; grid crosses itself.

knobs.label: Speed on 25–50% overhangs
knobs.explain: Walls that hang out a quarter to half of their width, such as a 30° overhang at 0.2 mm layers.

knobs.label: Speed on 50–75% overhangs
knobs.explain: Walls that hang out half to three quarters of their width, such as a 45° overhang at 0.2 mm layers. Thin bridged features, such as fine grid bars, often print at this speed too.

knobs.label: Speed on 75–100% overhangs
knobs.explain: Walls that hang out most of their width, such as 60° overhangs and steeper.

knobs.label: Outer wall speed
knobs.explain: The visible surface. Slower usually looks better.

knobs.label: Top surface speed
knobs.explain: The finish of the top surface. Slower usually looks smoother.

knobs.label: Solid infill speed
knobs.explain: Often capped by the filament's flow; check the Flow view.

knobs.label: Sparse infill speed
knobs.explain: Often capped by the filament's flow; check the Flow view.

knobs.label: Layer height
knobs.explain: Thicker layers print faster and show bigger steps on slopes and curves.
knobs.off_by_default: Changes how slopes and curves look; it's tried when quality is a goal or a limit, or when you turn it on.

knobs.label: Filament flow cap
knobs.explain: The most plastic per second the slicer will ask for. Raise it only after a flow calibration: above the hotend's real limit it under-extrudes.
knobs.off_by_default: Raise the flow cap only after a flow calibration of this filament.
